headline: An example week from a CS2103T team: run `npm run setup` to replace it with yours.

checkpoints.text: #49 merged, so four tasks can start
#81 merged last, after the other branches

bundles.name: Plug TAssist in
bundles.tagline: Wire the new data into the app first, then put it on screen.

bundles.name: New save file, old code out
bundles.tagline: Make TAssist data survive a restart, then delete AddressBook for good.

bundles.name: Groups, then attendance
bundles.tagline: Tutorial groups early in the week, attendance once weekly records land.

bundles.name: Students, then participation
bundles.tagline: The student roster early in the week, participation scores once weekly records land.

bundles.name: Weekly records, plus UI docs
bundles.tagline: Build the shared engine two bundles are waiting on, then document the UI.

49.title: Put TAssist behind the Model
49.headline: The app's Model starts holding groups and students, not just contacts.
bullets: Adds groups and students next to the old AddressBook, so nothing breaks yet.
Gives the GUI live lists to watch: the active group and its students.
Small on purpose. Aim to merge by Friday.

52.title: Show the active group and its students in the GUI
52.headline: The window shows the real active group and its students instead of AddressBook contacts.
bullets: Replaces the old person list on the Students screen.
Updates as soon as group or student data changes.
Shows a helpful empty state when there are no groups or students, and still fits 1280×720.
52.early: Build the layout today against TAssistBuilder fixtures, then connect it to the Model once #49 lands.

80.title: Save and load the TAssist data file
80.headline: Groups and students are still there after you close and reopen the app.
bullets: Saves groups, students and the active group to a JSON file you can edit by hand.
No file means start empty. A broken file means start empty, log why, and never crash.
Leaves room for attendance, participation and assignments to save their own records.
80.early: The JSON adapters only need the existing Group and Student classes, so start today. Agree the weekly-records format with whoever takes #53.

81.title: Remove AddressBook code
81.headline: The last traces of contacts, phones and tags disappear.
bullets: Deletes AddressBook's person commands, classes, sample data, test data and tests.
The app opens as an empty TAssist, and help, exit and view still work.
Merge it last so it doesn't conflict with other open branches.

50.title: Manage tutorial groups: add, list and switch
50.headline: A TA can create tutorial groups and switch between them.
bullets: `group add g/T01`, `group list`, `group use g/T02`.
T01 and t01 count as the same group, and a new group becomes the active one.
Students, attendance and scores all live inside the active group.

54.title: Record and view weekly attendance
54.headline: A TA can mark each student present or absent for a week.
bullets: `attendance mark id/A0123456X w/3 s/present`, then `attendance list w/3`.
Marking the same week again corrects the earlier mark.
Mostly a value type and messages on top of the weekly-records engine.

51.title: Manage students: add, list and delete
51.headline: A TA can add, list and remove students in the active group.
bullets: `student add n/Alice Tan id/A0123456X`, `student list`, `student delete id/A0123456X`.
Student IDs are unique within a group, and two students can share a name.
Tests set the active group directly, so this doesn't wait for #50.

55.title: Record and view weekly participation scores
55.headline: A TA can give each student a participation score from 0 to 5 for a week.
bullets: `participation set id/A0123456X w/3 s/4`, then `participation list w/3`.
Setting a score again replaces it. Bad input never touches existing scores.
Same engine as attendance, with a different value type.

53.title: Add shared weekly record mechanism
53.headline: One engine for "a value per student per week", shared by attendance and participation.
bullets: Weeks 1 to 13. Entering the same week again replaces the record instead of duplicating it.
Lists a whole group for a week and shows "Not recorded" where there's no record.
Written once because duplicated code costs marks.
53.early: It builds on the existing Student and Group classes, so start today and merge after #49 and #80.

61.title: Upload UI mock-ups and document the implemented UI design
61.headline: The guides show what the app actually looks like.
bullets: Puts the original mock-ups in the repo.
Adds screenshots of the real UI to the User Guide and Developer Guide.
Lists where the real UI differs from the mock-ups.
61.early: Upload the mock-ups now. Take the screenshots after #52 lands so they show real data.
